name: BACH_0196
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-2 priority flag; confirm invasion for drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 97%, InSitu 3% [F1] | Strong lead; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, 10% alpha (90% coverage) | Single class, 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 78% OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical input; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84%–88%); InSitu 79% [F5] | Unanimous neighbors; InSitu contrast |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · High (+1.12) [F2], 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+1.04) [F3], 18/20 spot check, caption mismatch · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.89) [F4], 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Nuclear morphometry** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · 45.5 µm² (0%) [F7], CV 93% [F8], TILs 92% [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001, CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); uses Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu mimics invasion (3% probability; contrast BACH_0063 is 79% similar).
- Invasion is absent and small-cohort calibration (n=132, 24 patients; coverage CI 76%–98%) overstates certainty.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 10, 11**: Highest risk (99%–100%); confirm invasion for drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 8, 4, 11**: Verify stromal invasion and scarce tubules versus duct-confined InSitu (BACH_0063).
3. **Regions 2, 6, 7**: Check measured nuclear variation (93%), TIL proximity (92%), and small nuclei.
